nodes.label: HR Executive Dashboard
nodes.description: Executive dashboard with org skill-gap analytics, readiness distributions, training priorities, exports.

nodes.label: Prerequisite-aware Learning Paths
nodes.description: Personalized learning path generation with prerequisites and learning time estimation.

nodes.label: Weighted Readiness Scoring
nodes.description: Proprietary readiness formula with thresholds ready=80, near-ready=60, developing=40.

nodes.label: Explainable Recommendation Engine
nodes.description: Weighted scoring: gap priority 0.30, role importance 0.25, resource relevance 0.20, difficulty fit 0.15, learning efficiency 0.10.

nodes.label: TF-IDF Skill Extraction
nodes.description: scikit-learn TF-IDF + cosine similarity used to extract skills from profile text.

nodes.label: Skill Intelligence Pipeline
nodes.description: CSV -> Data Loader -> Skill Profile -> Role Matching -> Gap Analysis -> Readiness Score -> Recommendation Engine -> Learning Path -> Reports -> HR Dashboard.
